To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the schistosome parasite and its snail host share a common 39 kDa antigen.
a 39-kDa antigenic protein is expressed by the parasite Schistosoma mansonii and its intermediate host, the snail Biomphalaria glabata.
a 39 kDa acidic protein is expressed in both S. mansoni and B. glabratab and that this protein may be involved in the host-parasite relationship.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a common protein in S. mansoni and B. glabrataby immunoprecipitation and immunoblotting techniques.
the expression of a common protein in the intermediate host and the parasite of S. mansomi and its potential role in the host-parasite interaction.
the characterization of a 39 kDa acidic protein that is common to the parasite and its intermediate host.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 39-kDa protein from B. glabrata is the same as Sm43 and Sm 39, but the 43-kDa component of S. manson i is not.
the 43, 39 and 39 kDA proteins from S. mansoni and B. glabratta are identical.
Bg39 is a cross-reactive protein expressed by the parasite and its host.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Sm43 and Bg39 are two related proteins, and that Sm39 is a truncated form of Sm43.
Sm39 is an antigenic component of the miracidial tegument, which is expressed by all parasite forms and is also expressed by the snail.
the Bg39 protein, expressed in both S. mansoni and B. glabratabut not in mammalian hosts, is a potential target for the design of vaccines for both organisms.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the 43 kDa protein of S. mansonii is a cross-reacting component that is antigenically related to Bg39, and that the 39kDa protein of S.mansoni is a cross-reactive protein that is antigenically and structurally similar to Bg39.
a common antigenic component is shared between S. mansoni and its snail intermediate host.
the 39kDa protein is a common protein in S. mansoni and its snail intermediate host, Biomphalaria glabrat.
